reaction: A list of his goals, kindly written - his daughter, the landlord, the doctor. I like that it is people. But the clock moved from 04:10 to 04:44 while I was reading and he already ate the pre-dawn meal without me. Did I miss something?

input.name: Would you rather have quiet while you work?

input: Speak then the line Would you rather have quiet while you work, then wait 20s
reaction: I tapped Speak at 05:13 and suddenly it was 08:00 in the workshop with Mrs Aydin. Three hours in one tap. The answer came only after I waited: he wants quiet. Fair. He said it plainly, I like that. Clock is stopped at 08:00 now, banner says stopped.

A quiet, sad man at a table missing his wife - I understand him at once. But the clock runs away from me. I said one thing at the workshop, then Let time pass did nothing I could see, Back to now jumped me to 09:33, and after ten seconds of waiting it is noon. I do not know yet when I am supposed to speak. I want to tell him to call his daughter.

input: Speak > Say something else > Plan something specific > take an afternoon shift, Urge, its your duty > Say it
reaction: I liked that it showed his likely reply before I spoke: Mention got I am grieving, Urge got I will do it. That is clear, like rehearsing a sentence. But after Say it the sheet closed and the page still says he chose to rest until 13:15. Did he agree? I see no answer.

input.name: Hacer is here. Stay and talk.

input: Hacer is here. Stay and talk. then Keep listening
reaction: Oh, this is lovely. We need not fill every silence, Halil. That line I would hear on the radio. But my shift suggestion silently disappeared - now the standing word is talk with Hacer until 17:19. So my new words replaced the old. I did not know only one counts at a time. And the conversation is marked Earlier - did I miss it while it played?

I waited thirty seconds and it went from 14:36 to 20:19 - the whole afternoon and the sunset meal passed and I saw none of it. Did he take the shift? I have to go look. The people are warm, but the day slips through my fingers.

reaction: (my first try at this pulse at 162s was rejected because I sent it wrong; written now at 167s.) I waited thirty seconds and the whole afternoon and sunset meal passed unseen. Now in the Today diary I see it: he agreed to the shift, but when Hacer came I told him stay and talk, and that stopped the shift after 79 minutes. I did that to him myself. That stings, and the diary is the only place it was told to me.

reaction: The day ended on its own while I read the diary - the panel vanished under my finger. The summary is kind and plain: he kept the fast, he trusts me a little more. But it says In the end he agreed twice and also took the shift - chose something else. Both true I suppose. Tomorrow I want him to call Selin himself.

The baker boy watching him work. It is easier when I take one part at a time. Small and true. I am learning the rhythm: the day stops for little scenes, then runs. I am waiting now for him to be choosing so I can say call Selin.

input: Plan > see the doctor, Mention, for Selin > previewed reply > Say nothing
reaction: He said he wants to finish his repair, thinking of the money. After yesterday I will not pull him off his work again. I chose Say nothing. Nice that I could see his answer first and step back.

input: Speak > Go and see the doctor. then Today panel
reaction: He put me off twice: after I rest, then after I sleep. Then he went to sleep anyway. Like a real stubborn man, I recognise my own uncle. But the Today list is very long now and I have to scroll through all of yesterday to find this morning. The newest is at the bottom. Hacer making a tiny paper room with a large window - I would like to hear more of her.

input: requested layout check: resize 1280x800, shot current-wide.png, position tap Latest at 1205,628, then back to phone
reaction: On the big screen the diary sits beside the scene and I can see my words and his answer together - that is easier, I do not have to leave the scene. Here, with plain mention, he put the shift off: after I rest. Yesterday Urge got a yes.

He keeps resting. After I finish this, he said, and then he rests again, and again. My suggestion sits up there until 15:51 like a note on the fridge. I am starting to feel like a nagging voice that he ignores, which maybe is the point, but it is a little sad to watch.

input.name: Which part of that memory stays with you?

input: Which part of that memory stays with you, then waited 12s
reaction: The empty place is hard to look at. That one reached me. But I notice Hacer and Halil said word for word the same lines as yesterday at the door - the radio play is repeating its tape. And the answer took twelve real seconds to appear; I nearly tapped away.

The words are tender and I like Halil and Hacer. But I keep asking him to do things and he slides past them, and my shift suggestion just quietly vanished. I am not sure whether I am helping. Still curious about Selin calling tonight.

input: Plan > see the doctor > Urge > for Selin > Insist > then Say nothing
reaction: Insist would make him go, but under protest, and it says he will remember. He is about to pray. I will not push a man to the clinic in the middle of his prayer. Said nothing. I like that the game told me the cost in plain words before I chose.

After I finish resting. Again. Every time it is after I finish. I begin to understand him - grief makes you put off everything - but I also begin to want to shake the phone. I will wait and see if he really calls before 21:02.

input.name: Stay on the phone with Selin.

reaction: He called her! I did not want to say that to an empty room. I had a lump in my throat for a moment. This is the first time I felt my word mattered. Though I am not sure if he called or she called - the scene does not say who dialled.

input: Day 2 over: chose take the afternoon shift (Mention, its your duty) and see the doctor (Mention, your health)
reaction: Twelve days skip by in one button! I did not expect that - I thought I would live every day. It is a relief and a little sad; I will miss the call with Selin. The note explains clearly that the shift needs duty or Urge, I am grateful for that. I wanted to also pick call Selin but only two are allowed. I chose rent and doctor.

He went to the clinic! And took a walk instead of a cigarette on his own - that made me smile. But 284 lira, 16 short, due tonight at 20:00. One afternoon shift in twelve days. And He never called Selin, she called 6 times - so that lovely call on day 2 was her calling him, not my doing. A little deflating. Asked you to wait 56 times - that number made me laugh, poor man, I nagged him 56 times.

Mr Demir says the very same lines Mrs Aydin said on day one - You are quiet when you work, I will let you work then. Same script, different name. That breaks the spell a little; in a radio drama I would notice.

Now there is a real deadline - 16 lira by 20:00 - and I care whether he makes it. The twelve-day summary pulled me back in. I am letting him finish his morning work and waiting to push for the afternoon shift.

input.name: It is good to hear Hacer with you.

input: Speak > Say something else > Plan something specific > Say nothing
reaction: I wanted to set the afternoon shift ahead of time but it is not in the list at 11:17 - only sleep, Hacer, rest, wait, pray. I suppose it only appears near the hour. I have to catch the right moment, and I am nervous I will miss it while the clock runs.

Wait - He has 0 lira, and now 300 lira is owed by Ramadan 30. Did he already pay Osman this morning? Nobody told me! The big moment I was nervous about happened offstage. I am relieved but cheated of the scene. I will check the diary.

So he paid Osman 300 by the deadline - good, but I learned it from a list. And now he owes another 300 by the end of Ramadan. Confusing: the panel says he last called on Ramadan 2, but the twelve-day summary said he never called Selin. Which is it? And see the doctor says chose something else while just below it says he saw the doctor. These estimates lines confuse me more than they help. I have to read the whole panel like a ledger.

After I finish this task, after I finish this task. Now it is Hacer at the door again. Mention never works for the shift and I keep forgetting to Urge. I feel like I am talking to a wall, and the scenes repeat. If this were a radio play I would turn the dial for a minute. I will keep going.

input: Plan > take an afternoon shift > Urge, its your duty > Say it; waited 10s
reaction: Previewed I will do it, said it. Ten seconds later it is 17:51 and he is resting. Did he work the shift? The screen does not say. I have to open the diary again to find out what my words did. I will not, this time; I will ask him to call Selin.

reaction: I am lonely, if I am honest. I would rather stand here than go back inside. That is a good line, and new. Hacer three times now at the door - she is the real friend in this story. The Speak button disappeared under my finger as the scene arrived.

input.name: Hacer is here. Stay and talk.

reaction: Warm lines from Hacer keep me, but it is the same doorway again and again and I mostly wait. I told him stay with her - he said he was lonely. That feels right.

input: position tap Go for a walk by the river (180,345) on phone screenshot
reaction: This moment I liked very much - the game stopped and told me plainly, he is reaching for a cigarette, the doctor said walk. Big clear buttons, a walk by the river. That is exactly the kind of moment I want. But he still chose to smoke until 19:51 on the line above - did he hear me before or after the match was lit?

input: Plan > call Selin, Mention, you shouldnt be alone > Say it
reaction: He is on the phone with Selin - and it is the exact same words as on day 2: I did not want to say that to an empty room. The first time it moved me. The second time it feels like a recording. I hope this time it is him dialling. The walk interrupted, though - my walk suggestion gone, replaced again. I am slowly learning only one word stands at a time.

Process slip: I sent those three skip-screen taps in one batch instead of waiting for each reply. They were selections on a static screen, not clock-moving inputs. Chose afternoon shift with Urge and duty, plus call Selin for Selin. The money hint here is clear, I like that it tells me plainly Mention is not enough.

Ouch. I urged the shift with duty and he did it once in 14 days, yet he called Selin all 14. 246 lira, 300 owed tonight. The screen said Urge would work and it did not, or I do not understand why. But Selin every day makes me glad, she is not alone now. Tomorrow I must be silent, that is a lovely idea.
Last day, 54 lira short, and at this hour I can only offer rest, sleep, prayer, water. I want to say go earn the money but that word is not here yet. Selin calls every day now, that part warms me.
I said nothing because he was already leaning to repair and earn money. And then he went home to rest instead. I thought silence meant let him keep working. Annoying.
These Hacer lines at the door are new and gentle. I am glad I opened the door. This is the part of the game I like, two old people being kind.
Feedback panel has I would keep playing, Not sure, I would stop here, a text box and Submit. No I am stopping or I am confused button exactly. I tapped nothing there, submitted nothing, went Back.

I stop here. He is 54 lira short on the last day and the work choice is not in my list when I want it, and when I stayed quiet he walked home anyway. I cannot tell any more what my words do for the money. The Hacer and Selin moments I liked, they felt like real neighbours. I might come back another evening to see Eid, not to fight the lira again.
